title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: Cafe
Alright, once again...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: My name is Kawanishi of Happiness Home Research, and I'll be helping you find a nice property.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
So, getting right to the matter at hand...
You're looking for a place you can base yourselves out of, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Our very own place...
The MORE MORE HOUSE...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, it would be helpful to have a place for the group to call home moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We just talked about all the trouble we've been running into booking meeting rooms...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, our new home could triple as one of those, a place for us to practice and a studio for our streams. We wouldn't have to spend as much time moving back and forth.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been so busy lately that time is really starting to come at a premium. I think it's worth considering this option.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree as well...!
After all, we can only do so much up on the school's rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, you all bring up good points.
It would be really nice to have a place that sort of doubles as our home base...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But is this plan really possible?
It's like us trying to rent our dream home!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, we can't afford a lavish palace that's right next to a major terminal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we should be able to figure something out by discussing our wants and needs, and compromising where we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
And because we've been getting steady work, we have a slightly bigger budget now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In any case, we should probably ask a realtor for further advice concerning this matter...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Since we're on a budget, I'll try to find a trustworthy agency that can still show us affordable options.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll need to stay here for a little while longer... But I'll let you all know once I've found a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see what kind of houses are available...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is so exciting...!)

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: I have documents on some potential candidates that we can look at together.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Ms. Saito also already told me about your group's needs, so we can discuss those further and see what's going to be absolutely necessary.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What we're looking for is...
A place with space for us to do our streams, practice and have meetings...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Offices that are available for lease usually come up when I enter those things in...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: However, there was also mention that you'd prefer to have a shower. That made me consider more residential places as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Not many of those kinds of offices have showers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I'm having trouble imagining what a room where we'd practice dancing and stuff would look like in a regular house.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The first property I'd like to have you all look at more or less covers that. Please tell me what you think...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! This is amazing...!
It's a plain old house, but the basement's all covered in mirrors like a dance studio!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only that, it has all these sliding doors that allow you to cover them up. And this says it's even been soundproofed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This looks incredible!
We can definitely use it as a studio for practicing and streaming.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, and on the first floor, there's a spacious living room and a nice kitchen with an island.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An island?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like the counters you see in the home ec room. That'll make it a lot easier to do cooking streams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, all we'd have to do is place the camera in the living room. Those streams would be like our own cooking program!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, what's this at the far end of the balcony...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Oh, that's an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-There's an outdoor bath...?!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: It doesn't look very big based on this floor plan... But it should still be nice for when you want a change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm staggered...
I wasn't expecting to hear about an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-Me neither...
A kitchen with an island and an outdoor bath...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Imagine living in a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work with the stream, Minori.
I decided to make you some salmon poke today to help you recharge. Let's eat our fill and do our best again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're done with your bath already, Minori?
And your hair's still wet. Let me go get the dryer. I'd rather you didn't catch a cold.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Talk about living the dream.
I'm not sure my heart would be able to handle it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's off in her own little world again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, I vote for this place!
Where do we sign?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, it even said on that one website how you should pick a place you can imagine yourself living in!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Calm down, will you?
Yes, this place does have everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we're on a budget.
Take a look at the rent...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
It costs...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It really costs this much...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Yes...
This is a five-star property that fits your group's needs to the fullest.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Now that you have this as a reference, we'll look at documents for these other properties...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: If any seem appealing to you, then I'll schedule us to go see them on a later date.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we get to see what they're actually like...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start looking at these one by one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Thank you all for your time today.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: I'll start scheduling our visit for the properties we discussed.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Also, I'll send another list of prospective candidates, so please let me know if you'd like to take a look at any of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Understood.
Thank you very much for agreeing to meet with us today!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Of course. I look forward to seeing you all again.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Browsing through all those papers was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually talking about this was pretty huge. Now we know that we prefer to have mirrors in the room where we plan on practicing, and that our stream studio doesn't have to be all that big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, we learned that we can go without a kitchen island or an outdoor bath.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would be nice to have those things, but I'm glad we're not choosing based on added luxuries.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, we get to see these places next time! I dunno if I can wait until then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, slow down... We're getting another list of properties to look through, so this is far from over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... But... We might actually get to make the MORE MORE HOUSE a reality!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then we could have sleepovers and stuff... How can I not be excited?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But don't forget that this is business.
We're looking for a place to rent because we need one for work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Yeah, I know...
This isn't all fun and games.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it means we get to spend more time together. That makes me really happy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Choosing just one out of a big list isn't going to be easy... But we gotta pick the best place available to us to turn into the MORE MORE HOUSE!)
One week later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This day we've been waiting for... It's finally arrived...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We get to look at prospective properties for the MORE MORE HOUSE!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! We get to go house hunting♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm very much looking forward to seeing what's on the table!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That Kawanishi person found the places you'll be going to see today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's right.
Some are newer than others and they're all by different stations, but they all have the things we need.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Plus, they're all within budget.
If we do happen to find the right one, then it'd be great to close the deal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Umm... I have a question.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ask away, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, we all decided to tag along since house hunting sounded like a lot of fun...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But are you sure we won't be getting in the way? You're essentially choosing the office for your business...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all more than welcome to be here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Once the MORE MORE HOUSE is up and established, we'll get to spend more time with all of you. So, you should all be here for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, then... Thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, we'll help you inspect each one. We've also become quite good at hiding since you've been nice enough to take us to all those different places.>
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Ah, you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry. Were you having a call?
I can wait until you're finished...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
We actually just finished.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, shall we? Please join me in the car if you're ready to depart.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yikes... That was a close one...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Overconfidence can lead to mistakes, so we need to be as careful as ever.>
A few hours later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Alright, that was the last one on the list.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: It's unfortunate that none seemed to fit the bill...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't realize choosing a house would be so difficult.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They all seemed really nice on paper.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but the first one we visited had a huge pillar running through the middle, which would've made streaming a bit of a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The second one was ninety years old, but the pictures and floor plan made it seem like the perfect choice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the real thing told a different story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That one room in particular...
I became so worried that one of us would fall through the floor during dance practice.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I was sure it was a good candidate based on the photos that came attached...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, we also felt the same way...
It just goes to show how important it is to actually see the real thing for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But the third one seemed really nice!
It was clean and had the perfect floor plan for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, except for that giant hill we'd have to climb every time. That's on top of it being pretty far from the station, so I really don't think it's worth the trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It'd make for a great workout...
But we might regret it when it rains or after a long day at work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which would defeat the purpose of it being the MORE MORE HOUSE...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
No... If it weren't for that hill...!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I know how you feel...
Very few places are both that nice and reasonably priced. But there's always a catch. In this case, a large hill.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On second thought, I'm beginning to wonder if we're ever going to find what we want in our price range...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We may want to start thinking about increasing our budget. However, that also means us having to work a little harder...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: There's actually one more place that suits you nicely on paper...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, there is?!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't bring it up until now because it's a bit... Special...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Special...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Still, it may be worth a look...
There's still the question of whether the property will interest you or not.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: So, if you'll bear with me for a while longer, I can try asking the landlady to let us visit today. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, okay...
We still have some time on our hands, so it'd be nice to shop around a little more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, we'd love to go!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Then, please give me a minute while I try to get a hold of her.
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think is so special about it...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What if it's haunted?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh! Maybe someone really scary lives right next door!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I don't know about a haunted house, but I think we can handle having a scary person next door!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
She gave us the green light to visit!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The group before us just finished, so let's start heading over right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We get to see it?!
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still, why's it so special...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What kind of house is it...?)
Several dozen minutes later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Here we are.
This is the place I told you about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our fourth stop...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's supposed to be special in some way...
But it looks completely normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it's kinda cute...
The roof and paint job have this retro feel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It does seem nice. The station's a little far, but this greenery more than makes up for it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it was flat most of the way here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we can't let our guard down just yet. It might look nice on the outside, but we still don't know what's on the inside...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
It could be like the second one where we had a doorknob literally come off when we turned it...!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Well, shall we go inside?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!
The front door opens to a flight of stairs?!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, the landlady lives on the first floor, so we'll be going up these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It must be an over-under duplex.
I know someone who lives in a similar house.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And the area around the entrance looks pretty tidy. I'm starting to get a good feeling about this one...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm also really excited!
Let's go inside!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, it's not safe to push like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There's so much light...!
It's nice and clean too...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: This room faces south, so it's nice and warm. The other rooms have large windows as well, so there should be more than enough sunlight to go around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
How is it in terms of soundproofing...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd also be nice to see how big the other rooms are and how they're all arranged.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Then, please feel free to have a look around. Oh, the room that's down the stairs up ahead may work as a practice studio...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, I'm gonna go take a look!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, wait...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, she's way too excited.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm sure we all have things that we wanna look at, so let's split up and meet back up in a minute.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay.
Practice Studio

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So this is where we'd practice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's a little smaller than the ones in the other houses...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But something feels different about this place...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The floor's all scratched up...
Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The previous tenants also practiced here?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I decided to pop in since it seemed like you were the only person here.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<This place seems really nice...
It's well-worn, but also well-maintained.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It has this warmth to it for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think you're right, Miku.
The previous tenants must've also practiced here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I had a feeling...
These scratches remind me of the ones on our stages.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like I can see each step of their dance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm starting to notice all these really tiny scratches. They must've practiced here a lot...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Probably.
But I have a feeling it wasn't just the previous tenants...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think all the tenants who ever lived here left their various marks on this house.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Look closely.
Some scratches look much older than the others.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They came to live here and left evidence of their hard work.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Their hard work...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <In that sense, this place...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think it's full of everyone's hopes and dreams.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... I knew there was a reason why this place felt so different from the others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really like this feeling, and this room.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's such a wonderful place.>
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Now that you've all had a chance to look around, can I ask you for your thoughts...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Based on our expressions, I'm guessing we're all thinking the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, each room had just the things we've been looking for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'd love to rent this place if possible!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: I'm glad you all like it so much...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: However, as I mentioned earlier, this place comes with some strings attached.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we've been meaning to ask you about that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing seemed particularly odd or unusual about this place. It's a quiet neighborhood, and I didn't notice any cemeteries nearby...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, what I said has nothing to do with the property itself. What's special about this place is...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The application process.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The application process...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I was under the impression that we'd have to send in applications for any properties that we wished to rent...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, our parents have all agreed to be our guarantors, so I didn't think we'd run into trouble here...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean receiving approval for this property isn't easy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, on top of being high schoolers, we're still just getting on our feet as idols. We can't really deny the possibility of being turned away...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Actually, the things you just mentioned won't necessarily factor into whether or not you get approved.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can you elaborate a little further?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The application process for this property isn't what you'd call normal. That's what makes it special.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Prospective tenants are approved based on...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Whether or not they can make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our dreams...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: After looking at those other properties, I'm sure you noticed that this one is incredibly affordable for what it has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: However, that's only because the landlady wishes to help those chasing their dreams.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She does...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was wondering why this place was so reasonably priced. It seemed a little too good to be true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait a second!
If the landlady wants tenants who are chasing a dream, then doesn't that make us the perfect applicants?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our goal is to spread hope to as many people as we can and we dream of doing a show at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Right. Based on what your line of work involves, you should be able to clear the first few hurdles...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: But the landlady doesn't want people who “want” to make their dreams come true. She wants people who “can” make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: People who can make their dreams come true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What does that mean?
Does she want a guarantee that we'll be able to make our dreams come true...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But how is the landlady going to judge that...? No one can see into the future...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Actually, I don't have a good understanding myself. It's a bit of a black box.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Several tenants have applied through my agency in the past, but none have ever been approved...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's that hard to get approved?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is starting to feel like an audition...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, that's why I refrained from bringing this property up at first. I was afraid of dashing your hopes...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: However, if you're all in favor of “auditioning” despite everything I just told you, then I'll send in an application right away.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This really isn't gonna be easy, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think we should give it a go...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After all, it's a lovely house with everything we need...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think it's full of everyone's hopes and dreams.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want this to be our home base as idols moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So...
Would you mind sending in an application for us?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Understood...
Please give me a minute while I let the landlady know that you're interested.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
